$comment: Non-secret configuration for the Android Trusted Web Activity runtime (issue #884). Read by android/app/build.gradle.kts and by src/lib/native tests. webOrigin is the HTTPS origin the TWA opens; it stays empty for staging and production so a release cannot be built against a guessed host. Set it per build with -Pbiza.webOrigin.<env>=... or the environment variable BIZA_ANDROID_WEB_ORIGIN_<ENV>. Signing material never belongs here: see docs/android-runtime.md.
